On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

jobs.title: Office Administrator
jobs.description_text: At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add an Office Administrator to our team. In this position, you will support the day-to-day administrative operations of the company by coordinating business activities, managing office operations, and providing administrative support that enables efficient business operations. This role contributes to organizational effectiveness by coordinating schedules, supporting departmental initiatives, maintaining business records, and improving administrative processes that support operational success. Working cross-functionally with employees, managers, vendors, and business stakeholders, this role supports administrative operations, office logistics, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and business activities while ensuring services align with organizational priorities and established procedures.

By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. What We're About At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. De stageopdracht Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart. Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten. Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart. Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers. Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen. Wat bieden wij?
